title: 第18章 收获之日
content_zh:
算了，本来和这个养老鼠的家伙也没有缓和的可能，再得罪更多也没所谓。

    韩榆想到这里，也没再迟疑，对一大一小两只乌鸦说道。

    “这偷灵鼠，你们带去吃了吧。”

    两只乌鸦顿时在逼仄简陋的石屋内雀跃欢腾。

    大乌鸦抓起偷灵鼠飞出去，小乌鸦也紧随其后，消失在夜空之中。

    韩榆微笑一下，心想往后只需要偶尔以精血、养灵术加深与这两只乌鸦的联系，倒是不用再时常耗费血气，它们猎食偷灵鼠、蕴含灵气的昆虫，其实对成长的作用更大。

    这两只乌鸦，未来说不定能够发挥更大作用。

    第二日一早，韩榆见到了表面上恢复正常的李老道，昨日青禾坊市归来的狼狈好像只是幻觉。

    偷灵鼠的精血效果显然非常好，弥补了李老道的血气损失，也暂时满足了炼血功带来的焦渴嗜血之感。

    两人巡视灵田，见到没有新的偷灵鼠出现，心情也好了许多，这灵田里面可都是他们的收获，关系着他们以后修炼所用资源多少。

    “两位师弟，最近我们的青禾灵米成熟，你们灵田内没有虫害、鼠害吗？”

    韦师姐笑吟吟地走过来，问了一句。

    韩榆、李老道顿时心头一震，暗暗想到：莫非豢养偷灵鼠的，居然是她？

    要不然为何过来有此一问？

    正斟酌着应该如何回答，韦师姐又说道：“两位师弟有所不知，凡是青禾灵米成熟，必然汇聚一些灵气才让灵米更饱满拥有灵气。每当这时候，虫害、鼠害必然出现，而那些不成熟的灵田也必然因此受害。”

    “你们这一次运气好，其他师兄弟们把虫害、鼠害驱逐的干净，我瞧着你们灵田内也没有虫害、鼠害。”

    “但等到下一次，运气未必就有这么好了！”

    什么意思？威胁？

    李老道、韩榆心中想着。

    却不料韦师姐话锋一转，又笑着说：“所以，下一次，种植灵田的时候你还是跟我们一起种，到时候大家彼此照顾，更加方便。”

    “我认识一个很有经验的杂役弟子，到时候也可以让他帮你们来捕虫捕鼠，只需要花费一些灵米，很是便宜实惠！”

    韩榆、李老道点头应下，等韦师姐走后，李老道将嘶哑声音悄声传到韩榆耳边：“好像也不是她？”
content_en:
Forget it, there was no possibility of easing up with this rat-raising guy, so it didn't matter if he offended him more.

When Han Yu thought of this, he didn't hesitate anymore and said to the two crows, one big and one small.

"You can take this spirit-stealing rat and eat it."

Two crows immediately jumped for joy in the cramped and simple stone house.

The big crow grabbed the spirit-stealing mouse and flew out, followed closely by the little crow, disappearing into the night sky.

Han Yu smiled and thought that in the future, he would only need to occasionally use blood essence and spiritual nourishing skills to deepen his connection with the two crows, but he no longer had to waste blood energy all the time. They hunted spirit-stealing rats and insects containing spiritual energy, which actually played a greater role in growth.

These two crows may play a greater role in the future.

Early the next morning, Han Yu saw Li Laodao, who seemed to be back to normal. The embarrassment he felt when he returned from Qinghefang City yesterday seemed to be just an illusion.

The essence and blood of the spirit-stealing rat is obviously very effective, making up for Li Laodao's loss of blood and temporarily satisfying the thirst for blood caused by the blood refining technique.

The two of them inspected the spiritual field, and they felt much better when they saw that no new spirit-stealing rats appeared. This spiritual field is full of their harvest, which is related to how much resources they will use for their future cultivation.

"Two junior brothers, our green rice has matured recently. Are there no pests or rats in your spiritual fields?"

Senior Sister Wei walked over with a smile and asked.

Han Yu and Li Laodao were suddenly shocked, and secretly thought: Could it be that she was the one raising the spirit-stealing rats?

Otherwise, why would you come here to ask this question?

Just as they were thinking about how to answer, Senior Sister Wei added: "The two junior brothers don't know something. When the green rice is mature, it must gather some spiritual energy to make the spiritual rice fuller and possess spiritual energy. Whenever this happens, pests and rats will inevitably appear, and those immature spiritual fields will also suffer from this."

"You are lucky this time. The other brothers and sisters have driven away all the pests and rats. I see that there are no pests or rats in your spiritual field."

"But wait until next time, your luck may not be so good!"

What does it mean?threaten?

Li Laodao and Han Yu thought in their hearts.

Unexpectedly, Senior Sister Wei changed the topic and said with a smile: "So, next time when you plant the spiritual field, you should plant it with us. It will be more convenient for everyone to take care of each other."

"I know a very experienced handyman disciple. When the time comes, you can also ask him to help you catch insects and mice. It only costs some spiritual rice. It is very cheap and affordable!"

Han Yu and Li Laodao nodded in agreement. After Senior Sister Wei left, Li Laodao whispered his hoarse voice to Han Yu's ear: "It doesn't seem to be her?"
